Input unsorted, may be empty; negative weights can be skipped. Do not mutate input. No external files or tools.

Write Python function solve(s) that evaluates an arithmetic expression string containing non-negative integers, + - * /, parentheses and unary minus or plus, with optional whitespace. * and / bind tighter than + and -; unary operators bind tighter than * and /. Division truncates toward zero. Return an int. Do not use eval.

Write Python function solve(data). data has 'durations' (dict task->non-negative int) and 'deps' (list of [before, after] pairs). A task starts when all its prerequisites finish; independent tasks run in parallel. Return the minimum time to finish all tasks, 0 when there are no tasks, or None if deps contain a cycle or name an unknown task. Duplicate deps are allowed. Do not mutate input.

Write Python function solve(ops) that simulates an LRU cache. ops[0] is ['init', capacity]; each later op is ['put', key, value] or ['get', key]. Return the list of get results (the value, or -1 if missing). get and put both make the key most recently used; put on an existing key updates its value; when size exceeds capacity evict the least recently used key; capacity 0 stores nothing. Do not mutate input.

Write Python function solve(words). words is a list of lowercase words sorted in an unknown alphabet's order. Return a string with every letter that appears, in an order consistent with the list; if several orders are valid return the lexicographically smallest one (by normal a-z order). Return '' if no order is valid, including when a word comes before its own proper prefix. Do not mutate input.
